SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM FM.MROSENDINFO WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBRC' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(B.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, '001' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(A.KEY_2,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL((B.ITEM_AMT),0) AS ITEM_AMT, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.ADD_DATE,25),'-','') AS ADD_DATE, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.RD_DATE,25),'-','') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION_NM,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_NM, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION_ADDR,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_ADDR, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION_NM,' ')+'^||^'+ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION_ADDR,' ') DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, ISNULL(B.PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_TEL, ' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, ISNULL(B.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_CODE,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM FM.MROSENDINFO A, FM.V_FMMATPOINFO B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' ORDER BY A.KEY_1, A.KEY_2
UPDATE FM.MROSENDINFO SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
